problems: Length changed: 2009-2012 entrants trained 6 years (alumni grads 2015-2018, no PGY7 on 2015-16/2016-17/2017-18 rosters); 2013+ entrants 7 years (2019 had no graduates). Adjudicator assumes 7; alumni rows fix completion. Class size alternated 2/3 until ~2019, now 3. Ahmed Belal joined 2021-22 at PGY2 with the 2020 class, then was listed PGY6 with the 2019 class in 2024-25 and graduated with them in 2026 (alumni). Alumni page lists 'Steven Wakeman' 2023 who never appears on any resident roster (probably a fellow): NOT inserted into training_history. 2011-12 PGY7s Dodd and Wilden graduated 2012 but alumni list starts 2013, so no alumni rows. 2012-13 and 2013-14 roster files are images/PDFs transcribed by eye. DB programs.website is fine; roster_url empty. Phase 2: no new problems; the NPPES 'switch' for Priddy is not evidence and was not used.
terminal_pgy_note: 2008-and-earlier entrants did 7 years (Vogel, 2008 entrant, PGY7 2014-15); 2009-2012 entrants finished in 6 (Edwards/Patel 2015, Kulwin/Scherer 2016, Shaikh/White 2017, Ansari/Kovanda 2018; IU overview page 2013-03 'fully-approved 6-year Neurological Surgery Residency'); 2013+ entrants 7 (no 2019 graduates).
